historical_record.description: Works Progress Administration workers remodelled the police training academy here in Golden Gate Park and graded and paved a parking lot for it. The building is now the Golden Gate Park Senior Center.
The Senior Center in Golden Gate Park was dedicated on June 8, as reported to the Recreation and Park Commission.

On a selection committee's unanimous recommendation, the Recreation and Park Commission chose Germano Milono and Associates as architects to remodel and enlarge the Golden Gate Park Senior Citizens Center at 37th Avenue and Fulton Street, paid for from the Vane bequest.

The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $46,500 contract with Germano Milono and Associates for architectural services on the remodeling of the Golden Gate Park Senior Citizens Center, whose preliminary plans it had approved a year earlier.
